entities.name: Helligan
entities.description: A labmage of the Wojek League and chief of the Tenth Leaguehall mortuary on Ravnica.

entities.name: Wojek League
entities.description: The Ravnican league Helligan belonged to.

entities.name: Tenth Leaguehall
entities.description: The Wojek leaguehall whose mortuary Helligan chiefed.

entities.name: Saint Bayul
entities.description: Hibernating body brought to the mortuary; told Helligan to bring Fonn.

entities.name: Fonn
entities.description: Person Bayul asked Helligan to bring, to be found with Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Company in which Fonn is to be found.

entities.name: Luda
entities.description: A girl, the first crime's victim, actually a lupul in disguise who consumed Helligan.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: Event after which the first crime occurred.

events.summary: Helligan breaks scalpels trying to perform a necroscopy on Saint Bayul's body.
events.quote: He broke several scalpels when trying to perform a necroscopy.

events.summary: Bayul tells Helligan to bring Fonn.
events.quote: Bayul told him to bring Fonn

events.summary: Helligan is consumed by a lupul disguised as the girl Luda, which takes his form.
events.quote: The lupul consumed Helligan and took his form.

relations.note: He was a labmage in it.
relations.quote: Helligan was a member of the Wojek League on Ravnica .
The lupul consumed Helligan and took his form.
